visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A domestic tabby cat stands on its hind legs by a glass balcony door, looking outside at a rainy scene. To its left, a white rectangular dehumidifier sits on the beige carpeted floor. The lighting is soft indoor daylight. Yellow subtitles appear at the top and white subtitles at the bottom. (2) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a professional studio setting. The background is dark with vertical yellow neon lights. He makes a 'stop' gesture with his hand while speaking. (3) A rapid montage starts with a meme of a man being splashed by a large amount of water, followed by a man hanging from a burst ceiling pipe in a dark room. Then, a cartoon sequence shows a character with a green monster. (4) The host returns, pointing a finger for emphasis. The scene cuts to a construction site with a water main break and heavy machinery. A close-up shows a man drinking from a glass, then coughing in a black-and-white stylized shot. (5) An anime character opens a glowing chest. Close-up shots show a BRITA filter cartridge and a cross-section of filtration beads. A graphic depicts blue spheres being trapped by hands. A person in a bright, modern living room pours water from a BRITA pitcher into a clear glass. (6) The host returns to the studio, holding his hands out. A graphic on the left says '4 weeks change'. The screen shows close-ups of a digital filter indicator and a smartphone screen with a LINE app notification. (7) A final product shot displays the BRITA filter box and a full water pitcher on a wooden table in a brightly lit, domestic setting with green plants in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate viewers on why water from a dehumidifier is unsafe to drink due to potential bacterial contamination in machine pipes, and to promote BRITA water filters as a reliable solution for ensuring safe, filtered drinking water with a focus on regular maintenance.
